stem:
Priya hangs a metal pot from a spring balance in her kitchen and notes the reading.
What does this reading measure, and in which unit should it be written?

options.text: the mass of the pot, in kilograms
the weight of the pot, the pull of the Earth on it, in newtons
the density of the pot, in grams per cubic centimetre
the volume of the pot, in litres

teacher.key_rationale: Weight is the force with which the Earth pulls an object towards itself, measured in newtons using a spring balance. Option A is the trap for students confusing mass (kilograms) with weight; C and D name unrelated quantities. Key recalculated for the new stem: B.
